items.title: What Should Corteva (CTVA) Investors Watch In The Vylor Spin Off Fight?
items.summary: Corteva (NYSE: CTVA) won Board approval to spin off its seed segment as Vylor Inc., with a planned NYSE listing. The Board agreed to distribute all Vylor shares to existing Corteva shareholders as part of the separation structure. State Attorneys General have filed legal action claiming the Vylor spin-off is intended to sidestep PFAS related liabilities.
